_comment: SWARM addition (M3): the SWARM wallet's Rust addon, one binary per platform, as published by CI on the swarm-wallet-core release below. Too large for git (about 80 MB each), so scripts/swarm-fetch-wallet-addon.mjs downloads the one this machine needs into vendor/swarm-wallet-native/ and refuses it unless its SHA-256 is the one written here. The TypeScript wrapper is vendor/swarm-wallet-core-0.2.0.tgz, built from the same commit. See docs/WALLET-PANE.md.
